headline: Facebook gives users more control over their AI-powered feed algorithm
summary: Meta's new 'Your Algorithm' feature lets users describe content preferences in natural language for more relevant Feed and Reels.
details: Facebook is rolling out a new AI-powered feature called "Your Algorithm," allowing users to directly influence the content they see in their Feed and Reels.
Instead of relying solely on automated recommendations, users can now describe their interests in natural language, telling the platform what they want to see more or less of.
This feature, previously launched on Instagram, aims to make content recommendations more relevant and personalized, with changes reflected in real time.
Users can also manage preferences via an updated three-dot menu on individual posts, selecting "Interested" or "Not interested" options.
Meta may ask follow-up questions to gather more detailed feedback, refining recommendations based on user responses.
The introduction of "Your Algorithm" signifies Meta's broader effort to give users more control over their social media experiences as AI increasingly shapes content discovery.

headline: NHTSA Investigates Tesla Robotaxis for Speeding in School Zones
summary: The federal agency is evaluating allegations that Tesla's Model Y and Cybercab vehicles exceed speed limits while using the Automated Driving System in active school zones.
details: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has received a petition to investigate Tesla's robotaxis, specifically Model Y and Cybercab vehicles from model year 2026. The petition alleges that the Automated Driving System (ADS) engaged in these vehicles exceeds posted speed limits in active school zones.

This investigation follows previous scrutiny of Tesla's autonomous driving technology. NHTSA has previously opened investigations into Tesla's Full Self-Driving system for various traffic violations, including running red lights and driving on the wrong side of the street.

The Cybercab, which launched earlier this year, is also under a separate investigation concerning its lack of traditional automotive controls such as side mirrors, pedals, and a steering wheel. This new petition adds to the growing list of safety concerns surrounding Tesla's autonomous vehicle initiatives.

Waymo's robotaxis have also faced similar inquiries from NHTSA, including incidents involving illegal passing of school buses and a collision with a child near an elementary school. The agency is evaluating these allegations to ensure the safety and compliance of automated driving systems on public roads.
